title: WebSubEvent
description: Envelope for any MOSIP WebSub event (UIN_GENERATED, UIN_UPDATED, VID_GENERATED, CREDENTIAL_ISSUED, AUTH_TYPE_STATUS_UPDATE, CREDENTIAL_STATUS_UPDATE). The `data` block varies by topic — see the topic-specific schemas where they exist.

topic.description: WebSub topic the event was published on.

dataShareUri.description: Temporary DataShare URL — fetch within its TTL to retrieve the full credential / biographic payload.

data.description: Topic-specific payload (UIN, VID, credentialId, authType, etc.). Shape varies by `topic`.
